scope: evaluation partition: 24 cases freshly reviewed under the 2026-10-18 rubric.

protocol.authoring: Existing synthetic fixtures and author annotations were not changed by this refresh.
protocol.review: Two fresh reviewers received separately shuffled opaque packets. Each saw only the current rubric, title, body, commit messages, patches, and supplied review; neither saw annotations, scenarios, author identities, prior reviews, benchmark reports, or the other pass.
protocol.adjudication: A third isolated context reviewed splits and disputed references using only evidence, rubric, and A/B rationales. Uncontested A/B consensus matching the previous adjudication and author reference was retained. An absent-review conflict received a separate isolated recheck. Four malformed section pointers were normalized to body after verifying the text location.
protocol.limitations: AI assessments are not human ground truth. No external validity, model calibration, or patch execution is claimed.
